title: mcp_registry_quarantine_request
description: Request body for PATCH /v1/mcp/registry/{id} — the F7 quarantine workflow. Operator-only mutation that flips an entry's trust_tier (and the documented Cedar policy clause + rate_limit_per_minute). Emits a DSSE-signed :ui_mcp_quarantine ledger receipt BEFORE the HTTP response (Principle III).

trust_tier.description: Target trust tier. Quarantining (verified|community -> quarantined) snapshots the prior cedar_policies + rate_limit_per_minute into sibling fields and rewrites cedar_policies to a forbid(...) clause + rate_limit_per_minute=0. Restoring (quarantined -> verified|community) reads back the snapshot fields when present.

reason.description: Optional auditor-facing free-text justification (≤ 500 bytes). Carried into the receipt payload for SIEM correlation. Empty string normalises to null.
